name: freebuff
description: IDE local estilo Cursor com IA offline

scripts.install-all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix backend && npm run test --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.build:windows: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && electron-builder --win --publish=never
scripts.build:windows:portable: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && electron-builder --win portable
scripts.build:windows:installer: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && electron-builder --win nsis
